definitions.explanation: Physically cool or chilly to the touch or in temperature.
Showing a cold, detached, or unsympathetic attitude toward someone or something.

examples.japanese: {冷|ひ}ややかな⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
⟦{井戸|いど}→井戸：03977_ido⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{汲|く}んだ→汲む：02281_kumu⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷|ひ}ややかだった。
examples.english: The water drawn from the well was cool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷|ひ}ややかな⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちよかった→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: The crisp, cool air of the autumn morning felt pleasant.
I was looked at with cold eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{終始|しゅうし}→終始：15291_shuushi⟧{冷|ひ}ややかだった。
⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷|ひ}ややかな⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧にもかかわらず、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: Despite the cold reception from those around him, he continued with his proposal.

notes:
A na-adjective that describes both physical coolness and emotional coldness.

FORMS:
- {冷|ひ}ややかな + noun (modifier)
- {冷|ひ}ややか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (adverbial)
- {冷|ひ}ややかだ (predicate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷|ひ}ややかな⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (cold eyes, cold gaze)
- {冷|ひ}ややかな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (cold attitude)
- {冷|ひ}ややかな⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧ (cold response)
- {冷|ひ}ややかな⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧ (frosty stare)
- {冷|ひ}ややか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look on coldly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {冷|ひ}ややか: cool with a sense of detachment; often describes attitude or gaze
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧: straightforwardly cold (temperature or personality); more direct and common
- {冷|ひ}やっこい: colloquial for physically cold to the touch
